Category: Q&A
Title:    🐞 Before you report a problem: read this first
After posting: Pin discussion (in category)
-->

Sorry something isn't working. These steps get it fixed fastest.

## 1. Is it down for everyone?

Check [rolebranch.com/status](https://rolebranch.com/status). If something is down, we already know
and are on it.

## 2. Is there a fix already?

Many problems have a guide:

| What you see | Try |
| --- | --- |
| Import failed / wrong roles | [Import troubleshooting](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/3) |
| Sign-in link expired | [Send a new link](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/sign-in-link-expired) and open it within 15 minutes, on the same device |
| The PDF looks different from the preview | [Save first, then download again](https://rolebranch.com/help/master-cv/pdf-looks-different) |
| A run failed and took credits | [They come back by themselves](https://rolebranch.com/help/credits/refunds-when-a-run-fails) |
| Romy can't read a posting link | Paste the posting's text instead ([why](https://rolebranch.com/help/applications/reading-a-posting-from-a-link)) |

## 3. Has someone reported it?

[Search Q&A](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/q-a). If yours is there, **upvote** it and comment with your device and browser.
That helps more than a new post.

## 4. Report it

Choose **[New discussion › Q&A](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/new?category=q-a)**
and pick "A problem" in the form. It asks for what happened, what you expected, the steps, your
device and browser, and roughly when. The time matters: it lets us find it in our logs.

## Keep it private

This is **public**. Don't paste your CV, email, phone, or anything from your account, and blur
screenshots. If we need more, we'll ask you to send it through
[rolebranch.com/help/request](https://rolebranch.com/help/request), where only the team sees it.

**Security issue?** Don't post it here. See [rolebranch.com/security](https://rolebranch.com/security).

## What happens next

We reply here, add a label (`confirmed`, `fixed`, `need more info`), and once it's fixed we mark the
answer and link the version on [What's new](https://rolebranch.com/whats-new).
